name: permforge
description: Intelligent Salesforce Profile to Permission Set & Permission Set Group migration and modularization toolkit.
author: Vishal Parashar

scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build && oclif manifest
scripts.package:vscode: npm run build && cd vscode-extension && npx @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies --no-git-tag-version

analyze.description: Analyze profiles to identify permissions, tech debt, and overlaps

decompose.description: Decompose monolithic profiles into modular Permission Sets and Permission Set Groups

verify.description: Verify access parity between a source Profile and target Permission Sets

plan.description: Generate user assignment and migration rollout plans

cluster.description: Cross-profile clustering to extract shared baselines and isolate deltas

report.description: Generate visual, interactive HTML security and parity audit reports

strip.description: Sanitize and strip deprecated permissions from profiles

uap.description: Generate native Salesforce User Access Policies for automated assignment

mute.description: Generate Muting Permission Sets to selectively restrict permissions

lint.description: CI/CD enforcement to prevent deprecated permissions in profiles

graph.description: Visualize permission architecture hierarchy and dependencies

mcp.description: Start Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI coding assistants

pipeline.description: Execute or configure the complete multi-stage profile migration pipeline

retrieve.description: Retrieve profile metadata directly from an authenticated live Salesforce org

advise.description: Audit profiles for Dynamic Forms readiness and decouple non-default Record Types

assign.description: Automate live user assignments to Permission Set Groups with dry-run and rollback

prune.description: Usage-driven least-privilege optimization using Salesforce Event Monitoring logs

drift.description: Detect permission drift across environments and generate reconciliation Permission Sets

compliance.description: Audit profiles for SOC 2, HIPAA, and ISO 27001 compliance and generate evidence packages

pr-bot.description: Automated GitHub Pull Request review bot with visual risk diffs and security alerts
